extracted.intended_audience: Pre- and post-doctoral researchers (and prospective host researchers) from outside Japan seeking JSPS fellowships to conduct research in Japan
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and program descriptions for international pre-/post-doctoral researchers and their prospective Japanese hosts about JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan, including program types, target countries, durations, and application/contact pathways. Covers Summer, Short-term (PE/PA), Standard, and (ended) Strategic program overviews and where to find application guidelines and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program purpose — cooperative host-guided research
rubrics_metrics.description: JSPS provides opportunities for pre-/post-doctoral researchers from abroad to engage in cooperative research under the guidance of their hosts with leading research groups in universities and other Japanese institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research must be conducted under the guidance of host researchers at Japanese universities and research institutions; JSPS emphasizes cooperation with leading research groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-stage accommodation — multiple program types
rubrics_metrics.description: JSPS has several types of programs to accommodate researchers in every stage of their career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should select the program type that matches their career stage (e.g., Summer Program for young pre-/post-docs; Standard for postdoctoral researchers). Detailed application guidelines are provided per program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summer Program — target countries and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Young pre-/post-doctoral researchers from the US, the UK, France, Germany, Canada, and Sweden are invited to Japan over a period of two months during the summer to pursue research under the guidance of host researchers in universities and research institutions in Japan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as a short (two-month) summer research visit; eligibility limited to listed countries. See Summer Program pages for application procedure and selection details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic Program (offering ended) — targeted excellence and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Young and excellent pre-/post-doctoral researchers with high future potential from selected countries were strategically invited to Japan for the period of two to twelve months in order to build collaborative research relationships with Japanese colleagues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This offering has ended; when active the program targeted high-potential researchers and longer visits (2–12 months) to establish collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short-term Program (PE) — regional eligibility (US/Canada/Europe)
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide opportunities for pre-/post-doctoral researchers from the US, Canada and Europe to conduct, under the guidance of their hosts, cooperative research with leading research groups in universities and other Japanese institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants from the specified regions should consult the Short-term Program (PE) application guidelines, schedule, and selection process linked on the program page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short-term Program (PA) — regional eligibility (ASEAN/Africa)
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide opportunities for pre-/post-doctoral researchers from ASEAN and Africa to conduct, under the guidance of their hosts, cooperative research with leading research groups in universities and other Japanese institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants from ASEAN and African countries should consult the Short-term Program (PA) application guidelines, schedule, and selection process linked on the program page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard Program — for postdoctoral researchers from other countries
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide opportunities for postdoctoral researchers from other countries to conduct, under the guidance of their hosts, cooperative research with leading research groups in universities and other Japanese institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard Program is the primary route for international postdocs; see the 'Application Guidelines (Open Call)', 'Application Schedule (Open Call)', and 'Selection Process (Open Call)' pages for full eligibility, required documents, and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic / program-specific eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Different JSPS programs have explicit target countries/regions (e.g., Summer Program: US/UK/France/Germany/Canada/Sweden; Short-term PE: US/Canada/Europe; Short-term PA: ASEAN/Africa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must apply to the program appropriate for their nationality/region and career stage; consult the program-specific pages for exact eligibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application procedures and documentation access
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides links to 'Application Guidelines', 'Application Schedule', 'Selection Process', 'Application (Overseas Nominating Authority)', and an Electronic Application System (in Japanese).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and hosts should follow the program-specific application guidelines and schedules. Contact information for Overseas Fellowship Division is provided for inquiries; some application systems or documents may be in Japanese.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program outcomes and follow-up materials
rubrics_metrics.description: The site lists 'Program Procedure For Successful Fellows', 'List of Fellows', 'Number of Applications and Fellowship Adoption', and 'Research Reports of Former Fellows' for several programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants can review past fellows, adoption rates, and research reports to understand typical project scope and expectations; program procedures for successful fellows describe post-award requirements.
